Kerala.note: KSDMA publishes shelter names and addresses but no coordinates. RTI application recommended for geo-coordinates.

Karnataka.note: Shelter locations exist in PDF reports but no machine-readable coordinate dataset is available.

Maharashtra.note: MSDMA does not publish cyclone shelter locations publicly. Contact MSDMA at msdma@maharashtra.gov.in.

Goa.note: No SDMA geospatial portal exists for Goa. Contact the Goa State Disaster Management Authority.

Puducherry.note: No public cyclone shelter dataset available for Puducherry.

Lakshadweep.note: No SDMA portal with shelter data. Contact the UT Administration.

Andaman & Nicobar.note: No public dataset. Contact the Andaman & Nicobar Administration.

Daman & Diu.note: No SDMA portal. Contact the UT Administration.
